data.situation: At ten fifteen, Maya carried her borrowed kit to the learning table. Jo asked for help with a short invitation to the family session. Maya’s first draft left out the starting time, and the words crowded the bottom of the page. She crossed out two lines and began again. At the other end of the table, beside an empty picture board, a volunteer was giving a paper exercise to each visitor. This was an individual task: everyone would make a small card before joining a shared picture later. Maya cut her paper into a square and drew a straight line across it with guidance from the volunteer. The invitation was now ready to copy. She tucked her little card beneath the invitation, ready for the shared picture. Maya, thank you for adding “Family room, 11 a.m.” to the invitation. I will print it before the session. Leave the finished copy beside the pencil pot. You can keep your square card or add it to the shared picture after lunch. Please bring the art kit back to the desk by five. — Jo

readingBlocks.en: At ten fifteen, Maya carried her borrowed kit to the learning table. Jo asked for help with a short invitation to the family session. Maya’s first draft left out the starting time, and the words crowded the bottom of the page. She crossed out two lines and began again. At the other end of the table, beside an empty picture board, a volunteer was giving a paper exercise to each visitor. This was an individual task: everyone would make a small card before joining a shared picture later. Maya cut her paper into a square and drew a straight line across it with guidance from the volunteer. The invitation was now ready to copy. She tucked her little card beneath the invitation, ready for the shared picture.
readingBlocks.zh: 十点十五分，玛雅带着借来的画具来到学习桌。乔请她帮忙写一份简短的家庭活动邀请。玛雅的第一份初稿漏掉了开始时间，文字还挤在纸张底部。她划掉两行，重新写了起来。桌子另一端，一块空画板旁，一位志愿者正给每位来访者发纸艺练习。这是一项单人任务：大家先各做一张小卡，稍后再一起拼成大画。玛雅把纸剪成正方形，在志愿者指导下画了一条横跨纸面的直线。邀请函已经可以誊写了，她把自己的小卡塞到邀请函下面，准备稍后拼进大画。

readingBlocks.en: Maya, thank you for adding “Family room, 11 a.m.” to the invitation. I will print it before the session. Leave the finished copy beside the pencil pot. You can keep your square card or add it to the shared picture after lunch. Please bring the art kit back to the desk by five. — Jo
readingBlocks.zh: 玛雅，谢谢你在邀请函里加上“家庭活动室，上午十一点”。我会在活动开始前印好。写好的那份请放在笔筒旁。你的正方形卡片可以带走，也可以午饭后拼进大家的大画。画具请在五点前还到前台。——乔

glossary.note: a first draft是第一份文字初稿；本例是邀请函，不以绘画粗稿替代原document义。
glossary.example: Maya’s first draft left out the starting time.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅的第一份初稿漏掉了开始时间。

externalEvidence.definition: any of the various versions in the development of a written work

glossary.note: a square 是正方形；cut paper into a square 表示把纸剪成正方形。square card 中 square 作形容词，表示卡片呈正方形。
glossary.example: Maya cut her paper into a square.

externalEvidence.definition: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon

glossary.note: a straight line说明线不弯曲，此处是形容词。
glossary.example: Maya drew a straight line across the paper.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅画了一条横跨纸面的直线。

glossary.zh: 物体最下方的部分；底部
glossary.note: the bottom of the page指纸页下方；故事中是文字挤在页面底部。
glossary.example: The words crowded the bottom of the page.

glossary.zh: 为一个人设计的；个人的
glossary.note: individual作形容词修饰task，说明每个人独立完成；和D02可数名词individuals的句法及语境分别教学。

externalEvidence.definition: characteristic of or meant for a single person or thing

glossary.note: with guidance from the volunteer 表示在志愿者指导下；guidance 通常不可数。
glossary.example: Maya drew a straight line with guidance from the volunteer.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅在志愿者指导下画了一条直线。

retrievalPrompts.function: The line below the first draft
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain what is missing from your unfinished invitation and where the words are crowded.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你写的邀请还没定稿，时间漏了，字挤在纸页下面。怎么说明？
acceptableAnswers: This is my first draft. I left out the time, and the words are crowded at the bottom of the page.
checks: 意思与情境相符；允许其他自然说法
